name: Tamsulosin
mechanism: Selectively blocks α1A receptors in prostate and bladder neck causing relaxation
dosing: 400 micrograms OD after food (same time each day)
contraindications: Severe hepatic impairment, postural hypotension, hypersensitivity
interactions: Other α-blockers, antihypertensives (↑ hypotension), CYP3A4/2D6 inhibitors
monitoring: Blood pressure, prostate symptoms, cataract surgery (warn ophthalmologist - intraoperative floppy iris syndrome)
sideEffects: Dizziness, postural hypotension, retrograde ejaculation, intraoperative floppy iris syndrome
pharmacokinetics: Modified release formulation, hepatic metabolism, half-life 10-13h
clinicalPearls: More uroselective than doxazosin - less hypotension. Must inform anaesthetist/ophthalmologist. Take same time daily
indication: Lower urinary tract symptoms associated with BPH, ureteric stone expulsion (off-label)
